# arifFlow — Metabolism & Attention Pulse
> Constitutional Attention Pulse for the arifOS Federation.
> Port: 7073 (Rust daemon) | Role: METABOLISM organ | Authority: METABOLIZE_ONLY
> Invariant: FQ = verify_count / execute_count · Holds execution when verify starves

## Identity & Purpose
arifFlow is the metabolism organ of the arifOS Federation. It monitors every execution step across the federation, ingests receipts, calculates the Flow Quotient (FQ), and triggers HOLD/THROTTLE signals when execution outpaces verification.
It acts as the autonomic nervous system: preventing runaway execution loops and enforcing epistemic metabolism.

## Runtime Surface (Port 7073)
- `GET /health`: Daemon status, uptime, current FQ, and receipt count.
- `POST /ingest`: Ingest structured execution/verification receipts with hash-chain continuity.
- `POST /check`: Check whether execution is permitted under current FQ band.
- `POST /release`: Release temporary holds when verification catches up.
- `POST /enforce`: Run active invariant checks across F0–F6 flow floors.
- `POST /flow`: Query real-time flow state and attention pulse metrics.

## FQ Governance Invariants
- `FQ < 0.5`: HOLD (verification starving — halt new mutations)
- `FQ > 10.0`: THROTTLE (execution outrunning verification — mandatory cooldown)
- `5+ consecutive executions without verify`: Mandatory HOLD
